user.title: Connect to PowerSchool
user.description: Host is just the domain, e.g. powerschool.eastnoble.net -- no https:// prefix. Use your guardian portal username/password.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the username/password, and make sure the account doesn't require MFA or SSO.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach or parse the portal at that host. Double-check the domain and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error -- check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This PowerSchool account is already configured.

data_description.course_trend_sensors: Optional. Exact course names (comma-separated) to build a dedicated, already-filtered trend sensor for -- one per student who has that course, e.g. 'Algebra I-1, Biology I-1'. Check a Grade History sensor's course_percent_history attribute for the exact spelling PowerSchool uses. Leave blank for none.
